paragraphs: A Full-stack app command-line tool, open-source and ready to self-host: that's BirdBand. BirdBand is a single-file, standard-library-only Python command-line tool for bird banders: it saves a banding record per bird (band number, species, date, site, wing chord in mm and weight in g), logs recaptures of a…. BirdBand ships complete — source, design assets, seed data — under the Apache-2.0 license; no cloud account needed. Remix BirdBand on cenius.ai for a custom build.

▶ Open & edit in cenius.ai — one click to an editable workspace: describe changes in plain English, get an instant preview, one-click deploy and host. Modifications made on the platform come with full rebrand & relicense rights.

Records carry the name of the bander who saved them, so the two write commands need a bander to sign in as.
The session lasts 12 hours. birdband logout deletes it; until then, add and recap run without a prompt, and list and history never need a sign-in at all.
